text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — saw regional TPM drift after yesterday's us-east failover. us-west kept serving and token ledger didn't adjust, so effective RPM cap per-GPU got oversubscribed. Noticed 2x queue growth on the bc-gpu pool. Logs below.

Arun Patel: Can you paste the query that surfaced this?

Mia Chen: Ran `SELECT sum(tokens_used) FROM capacity_ledger WHERE region='us-west' AND minute >= now() - interval '15 minutes'` — results show ~120k tokens still attributed to us-east shards.

infra-bot: autoscaler: failover us-east -> us-west initiated at 2026-03-16T22:14:08Z, healthy nodes added +8, token-migration job scheduled.

Leo Gomez: Is this the same as token-smear we saw in jan? sounds like bookkeeping lagged after node tombstones.

Sophia Rivera: Probably. Our reconciler only collapses ownership on heartbeat or explicit migration. If tombstones were delayed, refill continues against stale owners.

Arun Patel: What's the user impact?

Mia Chen: Queue latency med jumped 180ms -> 450ms, p99 ~2s. TPM utilization for bc-gpu reached 92% vs SLO target 65%. A bunch of low-T models were starved; customer-side retries spiked.

Sophia Rivera: Short-term: run a ledger-replay to collapse stale ownership and force amortized refill. Mid-term: add sliding-window smoothing to regional token balance + an explicit drift-correction pass right after failovers.

Leo Gomez: Config sketch:
```
token_drift:
  window_seconds: 300
  max_correction_pct: 0.25
  amortize_interval: 30
  reconcile_on_failover: true
```

Mia Chen: Runbook to execute now?

Arun Patel: Runbook (manual):
1) dry-run ledger replay:
```
kubectl -n inference exec job/token-replayer -- /app/replay --dry-run --since=15m
```
2) check delta:
```
curl -sS http://admin.internal/capacity/ledger/delta | jq .
```
3) apply (force) if delta > 5%:
```
kubectl -n inference exec job/token-replayer -- /app/replay --force --since=15m
curl -XPOST "http://admin.internal/capacity/reconcile?force=true"
```
4) watch queues:
```
curl -sS http://admin.internal/metrics/queues | jq '.bc_gpu'
```

infra-bot: job/token-replayer started at 2026-03-16T23:02:10Z

infra-bot: job/token-replayer finished at 2026-03-16T23:02:58Z; corrected 112345 tokens, applied amortization window

Sophia Rivera: Also applying a temporary per-model RPM cap override for bc-gpu to 0.8 * normal to buy headroom. Example policy patch:
```
{ "policy": "override", "pool": "bc-gpu", "per_model_rpm_pct": 0.8, "expires": "2026-03-17T02:00:00Z" }
```

Leo Gomez: Monitoring: queue p99 back to ~600ms and TPM utilization dropped to 68% after reconcile. Will leave the override for 2h and then revert.

Mia Chen: Thanks all. Follow-up: Sophia, can you open a ticket to make drift-correction automatic after failovers and add a test in chaos-suite for delayed tombstones? :eyes:

Sophia Rivera: On it — filing now. :thumbsup:

Arun Patel: +1 to adding a guardrail. Let's also log token ownership changes to S3 for faster audit.

Mia Chen: Cool. I'll close this thread once the ticket is linked to the incident.
